name: Sagittarius A*
description: The supermassive black hole at the center of the Milky Way. The marker is its radio source position; it is not a visible image of the event horizon.
source: SIMBAD snapshot 2026-10-16: NAME Sgr A* (radio coordinates, J2000).

name: M87*
description: The supermassive black hole at the center of the Virgo A galaxy (M87). The marker uses the galaxy nucleus coordinates; it is not a visible image of the event horizon.

name: Cygnus X-1

name: Milky Way
description: The galaxy that contains our Solar System. This direction marker points to its Galactic Center at Sagittarius A*; the Milky Way is an extended structure and cannot be represented by one point on the sky.
source: SIMBAD snapshot 2026-10-16: NAME Sgr A* (radio coordinates, J2000); marker represents the Galactic Center.
